'''Fir Kashal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kashal was a member of a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that was led by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Koll Jovas]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the bounty hunters were hired by a member of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] to find whomever was responsible for some attacks on Cartel shipping in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and stop them. The attacks had been caused by the [[Rock Rogues]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group and when the bounty hunters arrived in the Cularin system in their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], it was shot down by a Rock Rogues [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]]. The transport crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and Kashal and the other bounty hunters climbed out of the wreckage, determined to find the pirates.

Shortly afterward, the bounty hunters encountered the Heroes of Cularin, a group of freelance agents who were also investigating the Rock Rogues. Kash, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Liinu Oran]], and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Jith Zesjoo]] hid nearby, while Jovas and two other bounty hunters approached the heroes.
